=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:336-345,1485-1489 + scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25344-25348 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On idle ticks, run_persist_postmerge_verify is called only inside the STANDALONE_RECOVERY_SWEEP_ONLY sweep block, so ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY also gates it. With that setting off, validate_env is skipped and the sweep step never runs.
  WHY: In a repo with no open tracking issue and ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY=false, armed ai:verify-pending issues are never graded, reopened or cleaned up, even when PERSIST_POSTMERGE_VERIFY_ENABLED=true. All five reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md:7-8 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The fragment's Marker bullet names the placeholder path `.github/workflows/f.yml` and its Check bullet names `scripts/persist_budget.py`, a P6 file that does not exist yet.
  WHY: Once the fragment is folded into agents.md, tests/inventory_parity.py fails with "FAIL: agents.md:1840: unexpected tracked-surface reference .github/workflows/f.yml" and "FAIL: agents.md:1841: unexpected tracked-surface reference scripts/persist_budget.py" (job 124551464311). Four other reviewers raised this as a task gap; see CONSENSUS TASK GAPS.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:module docstring continuation lines (tab followed by spaces, e.g. under "Switches") | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Docstring continuation lines mix tabs and spaces, which violates ruff E101. CI runs that rule via "ruff check --select E,F --ignore E501 scripts/*.py" (.github/workflows/ci.yml:377).
  WHY: The ruff step in static-checks fails. The earlier test_ci_wires failure currently hides it. Two other reviewers raised ruff and shellcheck as a task gap.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:529-534 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: cmd_arm posts the pending marker comment and then adds the ai:verify-pending label. If the label POST fails, for example a transient error or a label that does not exist yet, it returns and leaves a marker with no label.
  WHY: The step is continue-on-error, nothing retries arm, and check finds candidates only by label, so the post-merge check for that merge is silently dropped. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT; the other four rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:700-712 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the recurred branch, a failed post of the failed/recurred marker comment is only logged (comment_write). The function still returns True, so the re-plan goes ahead after the issue has been reopened and the label removed.
  WHY: replan_count() counts only trusted recurred markers, so it undercounts. The PERSIST_MAX_APPROACHES cap can then be exceeded, and ai:needs-human is applied late or never. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; the others rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:653-663 (check_one cache-hit path) + select_run() | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The per-tick runs cache from _load_actions_runs_cached (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16968) holds only the 20 newest completed runs repo-wide. If the merge-commit or first post-merge run has dropped out of it, select_run returns a later descendant run, and the per-workflow fetch is skipped. The `per_page=20` fallback has the same blind spot for the first run.
  WHY: A failing first post-merge run followed by a green later run is graded "held", ai:verify-pending is removed, and the recurrence is never reported. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:301-305 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: select_run prefers a run on the exact merge SHA over an earlier qualifying run on a descendant commit. The plan text (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:457) says to grade the first completed run.
  WHY: If an earlier descendant run fails and a later run on the merge SHA succeeds, the issue is graded held instead of reopened and re-planned. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised this as a related note inside its cache finding. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly did not raise it, calling it a documented design choice in the fragment.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:574,664-666,726-733 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: _candidates sorts oldest updated_at first and cmd_check processes only candidates[:cap]. The "wait" branch writes nothing, so waiting candidates keep the front slots on every tick.
  WHY: Three waiting issues can block newer, ready-to-grade issues for up to PERSIST_POSTMERGE_WINDOW_HOURS (24 h, or up to 168 h), which delays re-plans and widens the cache-eviction window. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:683-713 (PHASE_LABELS 97-101) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The failure path reopens the issue and re-plans it into ai:planning without checking for ai:security. PHASE_LABELS covers only ai:security-pass*, so ai:security survives labels_after_reopen.
  WHY: With PERSIST_BUDGET_ENABLED=false, security follow-ups that are meant to wait for a person are re-planned automatically by the `/answer` re-trigger, and they use up PERSIST_MAX_APPROACHES. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not raise this because the plan assigns it to P6.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:313-324 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: job_verdict matches the named job only by display name (`j["name"] == job or startswith(job + " (")`), but scripts/acceptance_check.py:377 accepts either a job ID or a job name.
  WHY: When the job ID differs from its display name, the verdict is None and decide() falls back to the overall run conclusion. An unrelated failing job then causes a false "recurred" and uses up a re-plan. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:821-824 (scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:141,370-375) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The env block of the "Arm check after merge" step does not pass PERSIST_POSTMERGE_WINDOW_HOURS, so pending_comment always shows the helper's 24 h default.
  WHY: With a non-default window, the comment shows the wrong deadline while the poller grades with the configured value. The agents fragment also wrongly claims the variable is defaulted in issue_pr_status.yml. All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:597-603 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _budget_owner logs "outcome=recurred reason=budget_absent" after the issue has already been classified as recurred and patched, which attributes the re-plan to the wrong cause.
  WHY: Log parsers cannot tell whether a re-plan came from P5's cap or from P6's budget. Both reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 called the wording cosmetic and did not raise it.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19544-19579 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: run_persist_postmerge_verify writes `_load_actions_runs_cached > "${ppv_runs}"` before the helper checks PERSIST_POSTMERGE_VERIFY_ENABLED, and the disabled path never reads that file.
  WHY: Both reviewers say this adds Actions-runs API calls on every idle tick on the default-off path; both rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this: prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:17115) already loads the cache in the parent shell, so no extra calls are made.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
